test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Sahana starts from point A and walks 6 km west. Then she turns left, walks 8 km, then turns left again and walks 2 km. Then she turns left again and walks 4 km. Finally, she turns right, walks 4 km and stops at point P. How far (the shortest distance) and in which direction must she walk to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° only, unless specified.)
solution: **Given: **Sahana starts walking from point A and walks 6 km towards the west. Then she turns left and walks 8 km, then turns left and walks 2 km. After that, she turns left and walks 4 km. Finally, she turns right, walks 4 km, and stops at point P. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db8d3197802058706f5f599fbad8b9265478a3a55ed16327be0e9ecf85d0cc60.png]
